name: Enkou Now (*＾ε＾*) ~Donna Ecchi na Onegai mo Suppo Shidai de OK♪~
original_name: エンコーなう(*＾ε＾*) ～どんなエッチなお願いもサポ次第でおＫ♪～
source:
"Support wanted!! I'll be waiting in the last stall of the men's restroom at the station~☆"
Horny and cute schoolgirl Kiritani Momoka posted such a support request on a dating bulletin board.

Students, old men, otaku and others all start contacting her one after another.
Momoka accepts endless desires of those horny men with a smile.
"If I can get some pocket money, I'll do any naughty things for you"

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk006/bm01/]official site[/url]]
translation:
“求支援！！我在车站男厕所的最后一个隔间等着～☆”
欲火中烧又可爱的女学生桐谷桃花在交友布告栏上发布了这样的支援请求。

学生、老人、宅男等纷纷开始联系她。
桃花微笑着接受那些好色男人的无尽欲望。
“如果我能弄点零用钱，我愿意为你做任何淘气的事”

[来自[url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk006/bm01/]官方网站[/url]]
